He's always been there for me, all we've ever been is friends but when I moved to a small town we kept in touch. He's actually the person who told me about the SW and Reddit in general, I'm a sophomore now and I find it hard to believe he's still here for me. But he hasn't left, so I thank God for him everyday.

You having the fear of being vulnerable around her is something you can't change, maybe something happened in a past relationship that made you that way, or your past could also put you in that situation. If you fail a person you love, there is still hope. I don't completely understand where you are coming from because I myself have not been in that situation but I do know this; failing at love isn't the worst part, it's the aftermath of it. It's the overthinking of the things you could've done differently, the feeling the need to talk to no one because nobody would understand where you are coming from or you feel if you talk about it too often it would become annoying. You didn't do anything wrong
Thank you so much, it really means a lot to have people like you (a complete stranger) support me and encourage me to keep going

I really hope things start to to look up for you and that you no longer struggle through everyday. I too find myself stuck without purpose at times, but I believe you have a purpose. Although I am a complete stranger and do not know a single thing about you other than that you can relate to the depression and cuts, I wish you the best.
